_notes: The overnight state for the Underdog run. Fired by the Autopilot holding step at curtain+210 (23:00 evenings, 20:30 on Sunday 27 September) and held until the preshow loop starts again at curtain-30. Deliberately quiet: by that hour the foyer is a handful of people finishing drinks, and a full rotation selling tickets and asking for volunteers is shouting at nobody. This is the fourth playlist described in docs/backlog/foyer-late-night-phase.md, finally built.
_show_when_note: Items carry show_when: "countdown" (there is a future performance), "final" (there is not), or "always". The engine already has to work out which case it is in order to choose between sub_countdown and sub_final, so this costs nothing extra. Between performances one card holds; on the final night the phase becomes a short three-card loop that sends people away with somewhere to come back to.
_policy_note: Between performances there is one card on a 60-second refresh - consecutive_repeat is true because there is only one card and the refresh exists solely to advance the countdown, not to change what is on screen. On the final night three cards rotate at 20 seconds.

items._note: The overnight card. Small type low on a dark screen, deliberately unobtrusive - the one place on the foyer display where the 56px floor does not apply, because there is no audience to read it at six metres.
items._countdown_format_note: {countdown} renders with units - '20h 00m', '1d 22h 30m' - never a bare H:MM. Measured 15 September: on four of the six nights the gap from bar close to the next house opening is exactly 20 hours, and 'starts in 20:00' on a foyer screen at midnight reads as 'starts at eight o'clock'. The Sunday gap is 46h 30m, which as '46:30' means nothing at all.

items.sub_final: That was the last performance of Underdog. Thank you for coming.

items._note: Dates and description from foyer-pack/next_productions.json. tickets_on_sale is false for Shakespeare in Love, so this card deliberately carries no booking link or QR - advertise everything, but only offer a link where tickets can actually be bought. Revisit when it goes on sale.
